note: Many-to-many tag. A profession may carry several of these. The NSDC roster is industry-focused and does NOT cover several regulated/public professional domains (law, government, academia, pure research, heritage). Extension tags below are prefixed EXT- so they can be stripped if you decide to stay strictly NSDC.

extension_tags.name: Education & Academia
extension_tags.reason: No NSDC SSC covers schools, colleges or universities as an employing industry.

extension_tags.name: Legal & Judicial Services
extension_tags.reason: No NSDC SSC covers legal practice.

extension_tags.name: Government & Public Administration
extension_tags.reason: No NSDC SSC covers civil services or public administration. Also the tag for Railways and PSU employment.

extension_tags.name: Defence, Armed Forces & Police
extension_tags.reason: Split from EXT-GOVT under the cross-cutting rule. Defence and police are cross-sector EMPLOYERS — an army doctor is Healthcare, an army officer is Law/Governance. Both carry this tag.

extension_tags.name: Scientific Research & Development
extension_tags.reason: LSSSDC covers life-science industry only, not research institutions (CSIR, ISRO, DRDO, IITs).

extension_tags.name: Arts, Culture, Heritage & Religion
extension_tags.reason: MESC covers commercial media, not museums, archives, classical arts institutions or religious institutions.

extension_tags.name: Development Sector, NGOs & CSR
extension_tags.reason: No NSDC SSC covers the social development sector as an employer.

extension_tags.name: Environment & Natural Resource Management
extension_tags.reason: SCGJ covers green *jobs* in industry; forestry, wildlife and regulatory environment work sit outside it.
